parent.note: R49O heuristic planted-deadcore hunting remains research-only and is not imported by the R50A controller.

goal: Integrate the Blue-Field / Tranception / executable-carrier bundle into the active width-4 TRUMP successor machine without heuristic ranking, ML prediction, stochastic sampling, semantic numeric preferences, or new proof authority.

exact_bundle_mapping.DOUGAN_DIRECTION: Every accepted nonterminal transition must carry a well-founded exact descent: R33 strict CLV descent or exact-DP strict variable-rank descent.
exact_bundle_mapping.FREESTYLER_TIME_REMOTE: Forward and reverse are implemented only as certificate operations. Reverse means SAT-witness reconstruction through an accepted transition, never physical retrocausality.
exact_bundle_mapping.BLUE_FIELD_EXPOSURE: For every current variable, compute an exact operational token from the R49I variable profile. Every token is exposed; none is probabilistically ranked.
exact_bundle_mapping.YA_MAMA_EXECUTABLE_CARRIER: The compact token may authorize CANONICAL_EXACT_DP only when its input hash and all fields are exactly recomputed and the R49H sufficient condition is true.
exact_bundle_mapping.TRANCEPTION_FORWARD_REVERSE: Accepted forward transitions require existing independent replay; SAT witnesses must have an explicit return path to the predecessor formula.
exact_bundle_mapping.RANDOM_LOOKING_ATTRACTOR_CONTROL: Variable labels and numbers have no semantic weights. The only tie-break is ascending integer variable id, used as a deterministic total order rather than a score.

operational_token_contract.execution_condition: RECOMPUTED_TOKEN_EQUALS_CARRIER_TOKEN AND bipolar AND chi_star<=4 AND exact_DP_independent_replay_pass AND polynomial_intermediate_envelope_pass

why_first_certified_is_not_heuristic: The controller is not optimizing a score or predicting success. Every accepted candidate already satisfies a sufficient proof condition or passes the full existing verifier. A fixed total order only makes the machine deterministic. To prove absence under the current machine, every variable must be checked.

reverse_contract.R33: successor SAT witness -> r33.reconstruct_model -> predecessor SAT witness
reverse_contract.DIRECT_EXACT_DP: successor SAT witness -> r42.reconstruct_sa_bve(DP record) -> predecessor SAT witness
reverse_contract.R47J_FALLBACK: successor SAT witness -> reverse stored R33 reconstruction records -> exact DP reconstruction -> predecessor SAT witness
reverse_contract.UNSAT: No SAT witness is fabricated; UNSAT authority remains the existing verified terminal/certificate chain.

expected_value.strongest_new_algorithmic_point: A genuinely lossy local token can trigger a sound exact action without reconstructing the whole state, because the token contains a theorem-sufficient local condition rather than a heuristic score.
expected_value.what_this_can_save: On states with an R49H-authorized token, the controller can skip the expensive R47J all-pivot candidate construction and execute exact DP immediately after exact local token computation.
expected_value.what_it_cannot_save: On the hard complement with no authorized token, correctness requires the full exact fallback or an explicit OPEN obstruction.

falsifiers: A recomputed authorized token produces exact-DP successor width>4.
An accepted DP or R47J transition fails independent replay.
A nonterminal accepted transition introduces a fresh variable or fails its required descent.
A reconstructed predecessor SAT witness fails the predecessor formula.
Static audit finds stochastic/ML/score-based authority in the R50A controller.
Controller reports absence without checking every current variable after the direct token lane is empty.
seal: EXPOSE EVERYTHING EXACTLY; EXECUTE ONLY WHAT A CERTIFICATE AUTHORIZES; RETURN THE WITNESS THROUGH THE SAME DOOR.
